text:
A detector is placed near a radioactive isotope and records a count rate of 700 counts/min.
The half-life of the isotope is 8min.
The average background count rate is 60 counts/min.
What is the count rate measured by the detector after 16min?
A
100 counts/min
B
160 counts/min
C
175 counts/min
D
220 counts/min
subject: Physics
